title.narrative: Improved labour migration governance frameworks in line with ILS through regional collaboration

description.narrative: ILO is engaging with tripartite constituents and other relevant stakeholders in the Arab States region to enhance the governance of labour migration and to improve the protection of migrant workers, ensuring their decent work along with a fair sharing of the prosperity they help to create. This is in line with ROAS Strategy on Labour Migration 2024-2027, informed by ILO Centenary Declaration on the Future of Work, the ILO Fair Migration Agenda, the 2017 ILC Conclusions concerning fair and effective labour migration governance, the Singapore Statement, adopted at the ILO 17th Asia and the Pacific Regional Meeting (APRM) in December 2022, and the Bali Declaration, adopted at the ILO 16th APRM in December 2016. This work is done, when convenient in partnership with the IOM organization. It is also hosted by the United Nations Issue-Based Coalition on Migration.
